epics.title: Web Authentication
epics.objective: Make browser-managed provider credential setup accurately reflect registry authentication contracts while preserving write-only secret handling and existing authorization boundaries.

tasks.title: Registry metadata and browser reactivation contract
tasks.objective: Expose safe credential metadata from the provider registry and make browser-only same-method reactivation validate merged stored values before atomic persistence. Keep Bearer API and CLI disabled-rotation behavior unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Registry-derived credential metadata includes labels, help text, required flags, multiline hints, and configured field names without exposing secret values.
Vertex service-account JSON is the only registry field marked multiline.
Same-method browser PATCH can reactivate disabled credentials after merged validation and atomic persistence.
Failed merged validation leaves disabled credential state and stored values unchanged.
Bearer Control API and CLI disabled-rotation rejection behavior remains unchanged.
Configuration-check responses describe only Gantry-side credential resolution and projection, not upstream connectivity.
Automated coverage iterates every executable provider and authentication mode without real credentials or upstream calls.

required_tests.id: exposes safe metadata for every executable provider credential mode
reactivates disabled credentials only through the explicit browser option
keeps browser model provider configuration checks local
documents the control API with security scopes and stable operation ids

tasks.reviewer_focus: Conform to constitution/README.md and its modular-monolith, API, provider-boundary, and exception standards. Keep the narrow reactivation opt-in in the existing service and browser facade only; preserve the default Bearer/CLI rejection and never return secret values in metadata.

review_budget.reason: The active stage contains the shared registry/service/browser facade work plus its DTO/dialog consumer and focused tests; no provider-specific component, endpoint, migration, SDK, or probe is added.

tasks.title: Shared credential dialog behavior
tasks.objective: Update the shared web provider dialog to use controlled registry-driven authentication selection, sparse same-method PATCH requests, complete setup/replacement PUT requests, multiline input rendering, draft clearing, and honest configuration-check copy.
acceptance_criteria: Anthropic, Bedrock, and Vertex first setup require explicit authentication-method selection before fields, Save enablement, or request construction.
Single-method providers keep the compact registry-driven form without a selector.
Same-method edits and disabled reactivation submit sparse PATCH bodies containing only non-empty fields.
First setup and authentication-method replacement submit complete PUT bodies with authMode and required new fields.
Switching authentication methods or closing the dialog clears unsaved values.
Configured stored fields are labeled in the UI without displaying secret values.
Vertex service-account JSON renders in a visible native textarea.
Verify credential is renamed to Check configuration with copy limited to Gantry-side credential availability.
Focused web and synthetic browser checks cover Bedrock, Anthropic, Vertex, and one single-key provider without real credentials or upstream calls.
